events.title: Rogue’s Dark Descent Demo Update — v3.10.0
events.summary: A large update is now live for the Rogue’s Dark Descent demo, focused on combat, monster behavior, persistence, usability, and overall stability. This update includes a lot of behind-the-scenes work, but the goal is straightforward: make the demo feel smoother, clearer, more tactical, and more reliable ahead of the upcoming press preview and Steam Next Fest.
